name: Catalyst public launch site, observed system

scope.summary: The single public catalyst.app entry page at 1440x1000, 1280x900, and 390x844, including fixed light/dark preference observations, waitlist trigger hover/focus, the open waitlist form, its email-focus state, and the live/simulated performance selection state.
limitations: No same-origin subpages were discovered from the public entry page; authenticated product surfaces were not accessed.
The 1440px desktop collector reached its 1,800-node cap out of 3,124 visible elements; screenshots preserve the full rendered page, but some late DOM nodes are absent from raw JSON.
Light and dark OS preference captures rendered the same fixed dark presentation; no user-facing theme toggle was found.
Canvas scenes, scripted scroll behavior, and animation timing were not measured as motion sequences.
Loading, error, empty, success, and disabled form states were not safely reachable without submitting the waitlist form.
Font licensing and the private product design system remain unknown.

evidence.note: Full-width launch narrative. Raw DOM evidence is truncated at 1,800 of 3,124 visible elements; the screenshot includes the full horizontal composition.
Dark-preference observation; root class, page surface, and full screenshot match the light-preference fixed-dark presentation.
Intermediate authored media band, 1000px through 1439.98px, remains a horizontally sequenced presentation.
Mobile layout stacks the narrative vertically into a 4,479.28px document and uses a bottom-fixed waitlist trigger.
Mobile dark-preference observation also retains the fixed dark palette.
Hover state activated on the mobile bottom-fixed waitlist trigger; no stable outer-node computed-style delta was isolated.
Programmatic focus produces a browser outline of rgb(0, 95, 204) auto 1px on the tabindex div trigger.
Read-only open overlay capture. The 423.48x426.66px form uses a #141414 surface, 32px padding, and two #0c0c0c fields.
Read-only open mobile overlay capture. The 299.57x340.88px form uses 40px block and 10px inline padding at the sampled animation frame.
Focused email input. The input itself retained no computed border, shadow, or outline delta in this capture.
Local simulated-performance selection moves the #262626 pill surface from the live segment to the simulated segment.

sections.title: Identity
sections.summary: A dark, cinematic trading narrative combines rasterized display type, near-black surfaces, monochrome particle imagery, sparse neon phase accents, and dense product-simulation UI.
items: The visual grammar alternates oversized editorial statements with compact mono system labels and believable trading-interface fragments.
Color is mostly restrained to cream/gray on near-black, then assigned by narrative phase: chartreuse for imagine, pink for research, amber for execution, and green for positive market outcomes.
Irregular corner-frame SVGs, fine connector lines, particle hands, and subdued grain produce a speculative technical character without conventional rounded marketing cards.

sections.title: Layout
sections.summary: Desktop and intermediate widths use a viewport-height horizontal sequence; below 1000px the same narrative becomes a 390px-wide vertical stack with full-viewport hero, phase panels, product proof, and closing CTA.
items: At 1440x1000 and 1280x900, the full-page screenshots extend horizontally through the narrative instead of creating a conventional vertical document.
At 390x844, the body measures 390x4479.28px and the hero occupies the first 844px viewport.
Mobile phase panels are approximately 281–286px wide; the transaction list is 322px wide with 14px card padding.
The mobile waitlist trigger is bottom-fixed at x=68.5, y=787 with a 253x57px measured hit area.

sections.title: Responsive behavior
sections.summary: Readable source media conditions define below-1000px, 1000–1439.98px, and 1440px+ bands; each band was sampled once.
items: Below 1000px, sections stack vertically, display type contracts to 32–46px roles, and the primary waitlist trigger becomes a bottom-fixed control.
The 1000–1439.98px sample at 1280x900 retains the horizontal narrative but scales the composition relative to the 1440px sample.
At 1440px+, hero display reaches 137px/123.3px and the composition remains horizontal.
Exact touch behavior and unsampled widths near the 999.98/1000 and 1439.98/1440 boundaries were not interactively tested.

sections.title: Motion
sections.summary: Static captures establish animated/canvas-bearing surfaces and state changes, but not motion timing or easing as experienced.
items: The root class includes Lenis markers and several canvases expose an accessible name of Unicorn Studio Scene.
The bounded collector found no nonzero CSS transition or animation durations in the captured mobile nodes; this does not rule out JavaScript, canvas, or transform animation.
Open-overlay screenshots were taken 350ms after activation, so their dimensions may include transform scaling from the interaction sequence.
Reduced-motion behavior was not captured; the light/dark preference comparison is not reduced-motion evidence.

sections.title: Accessibility observations
sections.summary: The public page has keyboard-reachable custom controls and labeled form fields, but several interactive containers lack semantic button/tab roles in the captured accessibility tree.
items: The waitlist trigger and performance options are tabindex=0 divs rather than semantic buttons or an explicit tab/radio pattern.
The waitlist form inputs expose accessible names from their labels, and the submit action is a native button.
Programmatic focus on the mobile waitlist trigger receives a visible browser outline; the focused email input showed no measured border, shadow, or outline delta.

WCAG 2.x relative-luminance spot checks on measured solid/composited pairs: cream/page 16.63:1, form text/panel 15.04:1, UI text/card 12.09:1, muted/card 7.11:1, step accents on their 10% badge composites 8.66:1–12.78:1.
Canvas scenes expose an image role and Unicorn Studio Scene label; many ordinary images have empty alt text and appear decorative in context.
No focus trap, escape-close behavior, screen-reader announcement, full tab order, or WCAG conformance audit was established.

sections.title: Assets
sections.summary: The page mixes Framer-hosted SVG/PNG imagery, inline SVG interface icons, five named webfont families including one variable face, and Unicorn Studio canvases.
items: Primary asset families include the Catalyst marks, full-bleed particle/hand textures, thin connector artwork, product-interface illustrations, token/vendor icons, and corner-frame SVG chrome.
Source font faces observed: FK Raster Grotesk Compact Blended, New Title Bold, Clash Grotesk and Clash Grotesk Variable, IBM Plex Mono, and JetBrains Mono.
Product-interface assets should remain visually subordinate to the editorial narrative: dark panels, small radii, sparse color, and no bright card backgrounds.
Font files were loaded during capture, but licensing and permitted redistribution were not established.

sections.title: Content voice
sections.summary: Copy is terse, declarative, imperative, and technical, moving from a high-level promise into a numbered three-step operating story.
items: Use short all-caps statements for major beats: INTELLIGENCE AT YOUR FINGERTIPS, IMAGINE, RESEARCH, EXECUTE & BACKTEST.
Use mono labels for procedural metadata: STEP NO.1, tickers, venues, timestamps, and action labels.
Pair confident capability statements with concrete interface evidence rather than explanatory marketing paragraphs.
The launch page intentionally presents sample trading data; downstream implementations must not imply it is current or live unless connected to a verified source.

sections.title: Usage guidance
sections.summary: Recreate the system as a tension between oversized speculative editorial layers and precise compact product UI, not as a generic dark fintech dashboard.
items: Start with the #0f0e0d page surface, raster-grotesk display type, and one phase accent per narrative beat.
Use JetBrains Mono for phase labels and compact source/ticker metadata, IBM Plex Mono for waitlist/form chrome, and Clash Grotesk for product-simulation content.
Keep step panels square and translucent; reserve 6px radii for transaction cards and 18–24px radii for pills/segments.
Treat particle hands, grain, and line connectors as atmosphere and sequencing support, never as substitutes for readable type or live data.
For implementation, replace tabindex divs with semantic controls while preserving the observed geometry and visible focus affordance.

sections.title: Known gaps
sections.summary: The public launch page is not evidence of the complete Catalyst product system.
items: Authenticated product screens, navigation, settings, tables, complete chart behavior, and transaction workflows were not accessed.
Form submission, validation, loading, error, empty, success, and disabled states remain unknown.
Canvas animation timing, scroll choreography, touch behavior, reduced-motion support, and a functional theme toggle remain unknown.
Source component names, semantic token aliases, font licenses, accessibility conformance, and design-system governance remain unknown.
Desktop raw DOM evidence is capped; rely on the screenshot for late-page appearance and recapture before implementing selector-specific logic.

agentRules: Treat this contract as a reconstruction of the public launch page, not the private Catalyst product system.
Reuse measured roles before introducing new values: #0f0e0d page, #141414 overlay panel, #0c0c0c fields, #171717 cards, and the documented phase accents.

Preserve the typography split: FK Raster for editorial display, New Title Bold for the alternate statement, IBM Plex Mono for form/action chrome, JetBrains Mono for system metadata, and Clash Grotesk for product UI.
At 1000px and above, preserve the horizontal narrative model; below 1000px, use the measured vertical stack. Verify boundary widths rather than inventing additional breakpoints.
Do not turn the source into a rounded-card dashboard. Square step panels, fine connector lines, sparse chrome, and a few small-radius product cards are structural.
Use semantic buttons, inputs, and a justified tab/radio pattern even where the observed page uses tabindex divs; preserve the visual result and record the semantic adaptation.
Never present the launch-page transaction values as live data. Use verified data, an honest static illustration label, or an explicit empty state.
Loading, error, empty, success, disabled, reduced-motion, and authenticated states must remain unknown until separately observed or clearly proposed.
Do not redistribute the source fonts or imagery without a separate rights check; the local reference only records their rendered use.
Recapture selectors and screenshots before treating this as current because Framer-generated selectors and hosted assets may drift.

checks.name: Capture completion
checks.detail: Four homepage theme/preference captures, one intermediate viewport, eight hover/focus probe captures, four waitlist open/focus captures, and one selected-state capture succeeded; two mobile probes for the desktop-only main CTA were explicitly blocked.

checks.name: Source visual review
checks.detail: Desktop, intermediate, mobile, open-overlay, and hover captures were visually inspected; the horizontal-to-vertical layout change and fixed dark presentation were confirmed.

checks.name: Responsive coverage
checks.detail: Samples cover the authored below-1000px, 1000–1439.98px, and 1440px+ media bands.

checks.name: State coverage
checks.detail: Waitlist trigger hover/focus/open, email focus, and both performance selections were captured without form submission.

checks.name: Contrast spot check
checks.detail: WCAG 2.x relative-luminance calculations on seven measured solid/composited foreground/background pairs were 7.11:1 or higher; textured and canvas regions were not assessed.

checks.name: Reference build and manifest
checks.detail: The deterministic emitter built four reference files and --check matched the canonical JSON, evidence hashes, outputs, and manifest.

checks.name: Generated reference visual review
checks.detail: Desktop and 390px local HTTP checks passed with no document-level horizontal overflow, zero broken evidence images after eager loading, all seven sections present, disclosures opening, and a visible 3px keyboard focus ring.

checks.name: Portability composition
checks.detail: An independent agent built a responsive Strategy signal card from design.md and tokens.css only. Desktop and 390px visual review passed with no horizontal overflow or external resources; the sample is explicitly static and simulated.

notes: Partial is intentional because the public site exposes one page and several required product/form states remain unknown.
The HTML specimen must be reviewed with the disclosed fallback fonts; it is not expected to reproduce the proprietary raster display face offline.
